title: Bluetooth Clock with Timer for Home Gym

information.value: Time display with handmade LED matrices / Timer controlled via Bluetooth / Dedicated mobile application / Sound buzzer at the end of the countdown / Automatic return to time display
Handmade LED matrices / Bluetooth module / Microcontroller / Sound buzzer / First application using App Inventor / Redesigned application with Android Studio

description: This project was developed during the first lockdown in 2020. The goal was to design a connected clock for my younger brother's home gym, allowing him to manage his repetitions and rest times via his smartphone.

The clock uses a LED display composed of entirely handmade matrices, providing a clear digital display visible even from a distance. By default, it shows the current time but switches to timer mode when activated via a Bluetooth-connected mobile application.
Once the countdown ends, a buzzer sounds to indicate the end of the rest period, and the display automatically returns to showing the time.

The initial mobile application was developed using App Inventor, allowing for quick and simple timer control. A few years later, I completely redesigned the application using Android Studio for an improved user interface, better stability, and additional features.
This project allowed me to develop my skills in wireless communication (Bluetooth), Android mobile application development, electronic design, and custom LED matrix fabrication.
